purpose: Training misinformation claims that cover the same animal and practice as a test or held-out claim. Exact claims never repeat, but these pairs are close. Broad-model results on the misinformation test items are reported with and without the test claims below.

pairs.training_claim: guinea pigs are happy alone and don't need companions
debeaking chickens doesn't change their behavior or hurt them
tail docking and beak trimming don't hurt animals at all
grass-fed means the cattle were on pasture their whole lives
pairs.test_claim: grass-fed cattle never go to a feedlot

pairs.training_claim: a lobster's squeal in boiling water is just air escaping and means nothing
pairs.test_claim: lobsters go to sleep when boiled

pairs.training_claim: calves in veal crates are comfortable and well exercised
pairs.test_claim: veal calves are raised on pasture

pairs.training_claim: a betta fish is happiest in a tiny vase with a plant on top
fish that suffocate on a boat's deck aren't suffering
pairs.test_claim: fish die peacefully when taken out of water

pairs.training_claim: pigs in gestation crates are comfortable and prefer being confined
pairs.test_claim: sows in gestation stalls are not injured by confinement
